digest.component_or_area: CI/CD integration test lane (pytest xdist loadgroup)
propositions: A crashing xdist worker running loadgroup/loadscope requeues the entire pending workload including the crashing item, causing repeated respawns and reexecutions up to the default restart cap of numprocesses*4, leading to exponential test execution time and CI timeouts.
Setting --max-worker-restart=0 on the integration loadgroup lane will abort the session immediately on worker crash instead of cascading respawns, bounding the blast radius.
The loadgroup lane in .github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml must be updated to include --max-worker-restart=0.
A contract test in tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py must pin the --max-worker-restart=0 flag on the loadgroup lane to prevent silent regression.
